E0327

A redundant `..` on a destructure that already names every field (D-DESTRUCT1)

What

A redundant `..` on a destructure that already names every field (D-DESTRUCT1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0327

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0327: tests/ui/destructure_redundant_rest.stderr.

Error [E0327]: `..` is redundant — this pattern already names every field of `Incident`
  --> tests/ui/destructure_redundant_rest.jet:8:35
    |
  8 |     Incident{id, severity, title, ..} :: Incident{id: 1, severity: 5, title: "boom"}
    |                                   ^^
 Why: a trailing `..` only makes sense when some fields are left unnamed
 Fix: remove the `..`
